text: Yara's driving test is sometime next week, third attempt. She's properly nervous this time. Text her good luck the night before and ask how it went afterwards.
Efua is vegan now, not just veggie. No honey either apparently.
Dafydd got his grade 8 piano result today, distinction!! Bring him a card when I see him at the weekend
so Ming's coming down end of the month, staying two nights. she doesn't drink at all so get some of that alcohol free gin she likes

Chat with Farid after five a side. His daughter Nia has her GCSE mocks early December and she's been really struggling with maths, he's thinking of a tutor. Asked if I knew anyone. Said I'd ask Barbara, she used to tutor.
Call Ethan back re the weekend
Lior allergic to tree nuts AND sesame. carries an epipen. don't do the tahini thing if she comes for dinner
Ricardo and Sofia are flying to Lisbon early March for their anniversary. Ten years! He wants to surprise her with dinner at the place they had their first date.
Arturo's audition for the conservatoire is on the 14th. He's done nothing but practise for weeks. Wish him luck that morning, and maybe take him for a beer the day after either way.
Niamh mentioned she's gluten free since the coeliac diagnosis, keep forgetting. Also hates coriander.
Book MOT. Pick up prescription. Bins Thursday.
Hana - theory test passed! Practical booked for over the summer. Her dad's teaching her in his old Fiesta which sounds terrifying
Tariq's mum has her hip op sometime next week. he's going to stay with her for a few days afterwards. check in with him the week after
leon only drinks oat flat whites, extra hot. if im getting the coffees on friday dont forget

Okay so voice note. Just got off the phone with Magda. Her son Theo is doing his A level results thing in August, they're both stressed obviously, he needs an A in chemistry for Bristol. Magda wants to do a little dinner for him the day after results whichever way it goes and asked if I'd come. I said yes. Also she's off dairy again, something about her stomach, so if I bring anything make it dairy free. And remind me to send Theo a message on results morning.

um so Wiremu and his partner are moving to Wellington end of the year which is huge, his mum's there and she's not been well. big leaving do sometime in November apparently, he'll send details. he was saying the thing he'll miss most is a proper pint of bitter, can't get it over there. maybe get him a nice glass or something as a goodbye
Jasmine's sister Amara has her bar exam results out on Friday. Jasmine said Amara can't sleep. Maybe send Amara a little something the day before, she loves those fancy salted caramels.
Must ring Dev about the flat.
Joseph Novak - Joe - new guy in accounts. Into climbing and craft beer, especially sours. Lives out near the station with his dog Pepper.

Lunch with Erin was lovely, first proper catch up since the summer. She's training for the half marathon in April and is doing some no-sugar thing till then, which explains the sad face at the dessert menu. Her boyfriend Ben is doing it with her but she reckons he's sneaking biscuits at work. She wants a running buddy for the long Sunday runs, I said maybe.
Yusuf's driving test got cancelled, examiner off sick. They're rebooking for sometime in the new year. He's gutted.
Sorted Saturday: I'm taking Nina to the station at 8, then picking up the cake for Barbara's 70th.
Barbara's 70th Saturday afternoon at the golf club. Don't forget a card. She mentioned she's run out of her favourite rose gin, hint hint
Aleksander says he and Fang are trying to cut out meat during the week. Fang's still eating fish though.
Ming passed her viva!!! Dr Ming Chen. Need to organise drinks, maybe end of next week when everyone's back
call w/ Lorenzo: his nephew got into the national youth orchestra, audition was back in June, results came yesterday. Lorenzo v proud. he said the kid only eats pasta with butter lol
Nia's driving test went fine? Forgot to ask Farid. Ask him tomorrow at work.

Dictated in the car. Ethan Olsen rang about his daughter's grade three ballet exam, it's the morning of the 9th and then her recital is a week after. She's six and apparently not nervous in the slightest, unlike Ethan. He also said not to book the Thai place for his birthday meal because he really doesn't do spicy food. Korma at most. Ask him which restaurant he'd prefer sometime this week.
Arranged to meet Efua for brunch sometime next week, she'll message a day. She's off caffeine at the moment because she's trying for a baby, which she told me in confidence.
Note for Dafydd's birthday: Welsh whisky, the peated one. Not gin. He was very clear.

So Ricardo was saying Sofia's mum isn't well and they might have to cancel the Lisbon trip. Nothing decided yet. He seemed pretty low about it. I should give him a ring at the weekend just to see how he's doing.
Grocery list for the dinner party: oat milk, GF pasta, no nuts anywhere, two bottles red, one alcohol free.
yara PASSED. third time lucky. take her out for a celebration drink, she said she'd fancy a margarita
Hana Khan said her brother Farid starts his nursing exams the week after Easter. He's really anxious about the practical ones. Wish him luck
Theo's got his grade 5 trumpet exam the morning of the 3rd, and a concert at school that evening. Busy day for him. Magda says he's chill about it.
Lunch on Wednesday with Tariq and Lior. Lior's pescatarian, Tariq won't touch mushrooms. That Greek place should work for both.
Send Niamh the recipe for the flourless chocolate cake

Long catch-up with Jasmine on the phone tonight. Her uni finals are mid-May and she's thinking about doing a masters in Edinburgh afterwards if her grades are good enough. She's also started doing pottery on Tuesday evenings and loves it. Her girlfriend Erin bought her a wheel for her birthday, which is apparently taking up their entire spare room. Jasmine's off alcohol till after the exams. I said we'd do a proper night out to celebrate when they're done, sometime in June.
Wiremu's leaving drinks are off, he's ill. Rescheduling for early next month.

Dev and Amara's housewarming is the Saturday after next, starts around 7. Amara's gone keto since January and is very strict about it, Dev has absolutely not and was eating crisps the whole time we talked. Their kids are both coeliac too so the food situation is going to be interesting. Bring something that works for everyone, and maybe a plant for the new garden.
Leon - interview for the senior role Thursday. second round. he's quietly confident. message him friday to find out
Aleksander's partner Theo hates olives. noted for the dinner.
Gym, then dentist at 3, then try to do the tax return.
Dafydd is nervous for his driving test tomorrow morning so text him early, like 7ish. Then call him in the evening to see how it went.
Ben's lactose intolerant but will happily eat cheese and suffer, his words. Also drinks a lot of Irish breakfast tea
Erin's boss was there too. Nice guy, apparently does triathlons. Erin's got her performance review the end of next week and is worried about it.

Fang says her cat Biscuit needs a dental op sometime next month, three teeth out. Poor thing. She's worried about the anaesthetic because he's thirteen now, and the vet said he has to stay in overnight. Her husband Aleksander is away for work that week so she'll be on her own with it. I should pop round the day after with some wine.
met Ming's parents at the graduation. her dad only drinks tea, no milk, and her mum loves anything with durian. very sweet people
Sofia passed her citizenship test! remember to get her something, she's into those little Portuguese tins of sardines lol
Note to self: Uncle Ricardo is coming over for lunch on Sunday. He's diabetic so watch the dessert. Mum's cooking, I'm doing drinks.
Lorenzo's sitting his ACCA exams early June. Says he'll be a hermit until then. Check in with him sometime mid-May maybe, see if he wants a study break.
Yusuf at the bus stop, mostly about the football. Nothing much else.
Joseph's partner is expecting in the spring! He told me at lunch. Get a card and the team can chip in for something.

Nina said her son has his 11 plus the day after her birthday, which sounds like a nightmare week. She's not sleeping. Send her a message the night before his exam, and maybe drop round some of those almond biscuits she likes a few days afterwards.
Efua's brother Leon has his music grade exam the same day as Efua's dissertation deadline, which is sometime the last week of April. Their mum's flying in to help that weekend.
Magda doesn't like red wine. White or prosecco only. And no seafood, she's allergic to shellfish.
Facetime Arturo on Sunday, he wants to talk through the audition feedback.
Tea with Barbara. Her granddaughter Hana got her first-choice uni place. Barbara's thrilled, and wants to throw a little party for her sometime over the summer before she goes.

Coffee with Lior and her girlfriend Yara. They're thinking of doing Dry January together but Yara's already caved twice this month. Lior's sister has her wedding in March and Lior's the maid of honour, very nervous about the speech. Should send her a good luck message the day before the wedding.

Remember Tariq's results day is the 21st and he needs a 2:1 for the job offer. He's acting fine but I think he's terrified. Message him that afternoon, and if it's good news we'll go for curry the weekend after.
